messages:
maya: Heads-up: SLO alert for hosted-infer-usw2 — p99 latency spiked and 5xx rate increased over the last 10m. Customer ticket CUST-12987 opened for repeated 502/504s. Anyone taking this?

ops-bot: Alert triggered: rollout.slo.hosted-infer-usw2.p99 breach at 2025-06-10T14:12:34Z. 5xx_rate=4.2% (rolling 10m). Alert details: https://datadog/app/alerts/abcd

sam: On it. Can you paste the alert query, and any top error tags?

maya: Query used: avg(last_10m):100*sum:requests.errors{service:hosted-infer,region:usw2}.as_count()/sum:requests.count{service:hosted-infer}.as_count() > 1

maya: Top error tags from sample: gateway_timeout, upstream_reset, downstream_handshake_failure

carl-support: Customer says curl calls return 502/504 intermittently. Example from customer: `curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'` -> `HTTP/1.1 504` after ~30s. Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/12987

leo: I checked traces in Tempo: a lot of requests terminate at our gateway with NO upstream spans. Trace sampling shows missing kube-proxy -> model-server spans for failing traces. Looks like a trace coverage gap between ingress and model pods.

irene: Also check prefetch/batcher logs — we've seen similar when kv-cache thrash + cold loads lead to handshake timeouts.

sam: Pulling logs now. Running trace for trace_id=0x9ab3c to get a full path.

sam: ingress logs snippet:
```
[2025-06-10T14:09:12Z] svc=ingress pod=ingress-3 conn_id=1789 "upstream handshake timeout after 28s" path=/v1/generate client=10.2.3.4
```

maya: :thinking_face: That looks like upstream model-server not responding. Can someone check model-server pod health and restarts?

leo: Model-server metrics show GC pauses and one pod restart at 14:05 UTC. Pod logs include repeated kvcache misses and model load timeouts:
```
ERROR load_model: timeout waiting for model to become ready (30s)
WARN kvcache: eviction high watermark reached
```

carl-support: FYI customer mentioned they were sending very large prompts (long context, ~150k tokens in some requests). They think errors started after a recent large-agent rollout.

irene: Large-context + cold-starts can cause prefetch/backfill to spike memory and block model readiness for >20s. Mitigations: reduce prefetch timeout or route heavy calls to dedicated/tuned variant.

sam: Quick mitigation plan: create a temporary routing rule to divert this customer's traffic to the quantized low-latency variant in usw2 while we stabilize model pods. I'll apply a canary route.

sam: Console snippet (admin API) to create route:
```
POST /admin/routing
{
  "match": {"customer_id": "CUST-12987"},
  "route_to": "tuned-quant-v1-usw2",
  "priority": 100
}
```

maya: I created the route change and am watching p99/5xx.

ops-bot: Alert resolved: p99 returned to baseline at 2025-06-10T14:17:02Z. 5xx_rate down to 0.8%.

carl-support: Customer confirms errors reduced after reroute. They'll run long-context tests and report back. Keeping ticket open for end-of-day verification. :thumbsup:

leo: Follow-ups: 1) add detector for single-caller large-context spikes, 2) consider increasing kvcache capacity or adding a short-circuit to route huge sequences to a dedicated pool, 3) investigate GC/backpressure surface on model-server. I'll file a Jira.

maya: Thanks all. If customer requests RCA we'll run a short postmortem. Adding this thread to the incident channel for visibility.
